title: Zanzibar With Children
excerpt: Zanzibar works well for families: warm water, easy excursions and friendly people. Tips on beaches, activities and health.
body:
Zanzibar is a lovely destination for families, especially after a safari.

## Which beach

The north coast (Kendwa, Nungwi) has small tidal differences, so children can swim more often. The east coast has rock pools at low tide that children love to explore.

## Activities for children

- [Jozani Forest](/blog/jozani-forest-red-colobus/) with red colobus monkeys.
- A [spice tour](/blog/zanzibar-spice-tour/) with tasting and smelling.
- Snorkelling in calm water.
- A dhow trip.
- Giant tortoises on Prison Island.

## Health

- Sun protection: hats, rash vests, high SPF.
- Mosquito protection in the evening.
- Discuss malaria prevention for children with your doctor. See [malaria](/blog/malaria-tanzania/).

## Watch out

Sea urchins in shallow water: water shoes help.

## Where to stay

Family rooms or villas with a pool.

Read our [family tours](/family-tours/) page or [plan your family trip](/travel-proposal/).
